defects: Mohammed's feet rest on tread 2, but his pelvis is at the height of tread 4's nosing while tread 3's nosing sits behind his calves, making him look like he is standing with slightly bent knees on tread 2 rather than seated on tread 3
His hands are pressed flat against the vertical front of his mid-thighs instead of resting on bent knees
tiles.fix: Lower and push Mohammed's pelvis back so his buttocks rest directly on the horizontal surface of tread 3, flexing his hips and knees so his thighs are nearly horizontal and his hands rest on top of his knees.

defects: Mohammed's pelvis hovers at tread 4 height far above tread 3's nosing (which crosses behind his lower legs), reading as semi-standing on tread 2 instead of sitting down on the stair
Hands are stuck flat to the vertical front of his djellaba thighs rather than resting on bent knees
tiles.fix: Drop his pelvis down onto tread 3 behind the tread 3 nosing with knees bent forward over tread 2 and hands resting on the knees.

defects: Contradicts the spoken line 'Accroupi sur une marche, les mains sur les genoux': in this medium crop tread 3's nosing is clearly behind his calves while his pelvis is up at tread 4's riser height with nearly straight legs
Palms are glued vertically to the front of his thighs with sharply bent wrists instead of resting on knees
tiles.fix: Seat his pelvis down onto tread 3, fold his torso slightly forward into a genuine crouch, and place his palms over his bent knees.

defects: Same semi-standing hover: pelvis is at tread 4 height well above tread 3's nosing behind his calves, with hands flat against the vertical front of his thighs
tiles.fix: Keep his pelvis seated down on tread 3 with bent knees supporting his hands.

defects: Chin lifts as intended for the beat, but his body remains in the semi-standing posture with pelvis at tread 4 height above tread 3's nosing and hands pressed vertically to his thighs
tiles.fix: Retain the upward chin tilt while dropping his pelvis down onto tread 3 into the seated pose.

defects: Pelvis is still hovering at tread 4 height with tread 3's nosing behind his calves rather than seated on tread 3
Torso and shoulders remain stiffly upright instead of dropping in defeat for b050
tiles.fix: Seat his pelvis on tread 3 and round his spine forward with visibly dropped shoulders.

defects: Only the head tilts down slightly while his spine stays upright and his pelvis remains at tread 4 height above tread 3's nosing
tiles.fix: Slump his shoulders and upper back forward over his knees while seated down on tread 3.

defects: Pelvis hovers at tread 4 height far above tread 3's nosing behind his calves, reading as standing with slightly bent knees on tread 2
tiles.fix: Drop his pelvis down and back onto tread 3 with hands resting on bent knees.

defects: Missing acting beat (b051): his hands remain completely open and flat with extended fingers against his thighs instead of tightening into fists on his knees for 'à mort'
Pelvis is still hovering at tread 4 height above tread 3's nosing
tiles.fix: Curl both hands into tight clenched fists pressing down onto his bent knees while seated on tread 3.

defects: Severe framing defect: Mohammed's entire head above the upper lip/nose is cut off by the top border of the frame
His pelvis rises even higher so he looks fully standing on tread 2 while reaching his right hand toward his foot
tiles.fix: Keep his pelvis seated down on tread 3 so his head stays fully inside the medium crop while he leans forward to touch his foot on tread 2.

defects: Framing defect: the top of Mohammed's forehead and cranium is sliced off by the top edge of the frame
He appears to be standing upright on tread 2 with his pelvis at tread 4 height while raising his hands for the prayer gesture
tiles.fix: Lower his pelvis onto tread 3 so his entire head clears the top frame edge with proper headroom as he performs the prayer hand gesture.

defects: Wrong gaze and acting (b053): his head and eyes are pitched down toward the bottom-right steps with closed lips instead of looking up the flight with lips moving
Contradicts 'accroupi sur ma marche' as his pelvis hovers at tread 4 height with tread 3's nosing behind his calves
tiles.fix: Seat his pelvis down on tread 3, turn his head and eye-line up the stair flight (toward upper screen-left), and part his lips to read as speaking to himself.

defects: Wrong gaze and acting (b053): his head drops even lower to stare down at the lower steps with his mouth closed instead of looking up the flight with moving lips
Pelvis remains at tread 4 height above tread 3's nosing in the semi-standing posture
tiles.fix: Keep him seated on tread 3 with his gaze directed up the stair flight and mouth slightly open as he repeats the sentence.

worst_problem: Across every 3D beat Mohammed's pelvis is positioned at tread 4 height while tread 3's nosing sits behind his calves, making him look semi-standing on tread 2 (and causing his head to be chopped off at the top of the frame in s09 85.2 and s09 91.2) instead of crouched on tread 3.
